title: Fix rejected drain PR #132 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-44)
description:
Drain PR #132 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-44`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-44 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-44`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-44` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- Scope creep: CV-227 tests and changes to value-analyst.md were not part of the original task
- Task description specifically limited changes to proposal.md.template and tests/planning-templates.test.mjs only
